title: One-pot ultrasound synthesis of polyaniline–ZnO and its synergistic effect on microbial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37856-37864
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04461H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kalpana N. Handore, Sumit B. Sharma, Vasant V. Chabukswar
In this investigation, an eco-friendly ultrasonic-assisted green synthesis was employed to synthesize a polyaniline–zinc oxide (PANI–ZnO) nanocomposite with particle sizes ranging from 50 to 60 nm.
